messages:
Maya: Guys quick PSA / not a drill: if you wake up at 3am to grab a waiver target, you are officially a legendary problem solver or sleep deprived. there is no middle ground. :coffee:
Tomas: I am both. grabbed a streaming guard and a frozen pizza. priorities. :pizza:
Zoe: Nets pulled a buzzer-beater? I missed it, feed me highlights. :eyes:
Ibrahim: Full clip: https://youtu.be/some-rando (12s) Turner with a step-back banked in, crowd lost it.
Maya: Court-bot: "court-bot: Reminder: tonight's pickup window closes at 11:45pm PT."
Nina: thank you court-bot. you are the real mvp.
Tomas: League drama alert: someone dropped their top waiver so now my bench is a museum of regret.
Zoe: @Tomas who did you drop??
Tomas: dropped Huerter for a streamer, immediate regret.
Ibrahim: trade idea floating: I give Huerter + next week's 2nd rounder for Tomas's PG help. low-key tempted to propose formally.
Maya: poll: who takes the conference semis if these squads meet? React: 🟢 Celtics / 🟡 Bucks / 🔴 Heat / 🔵 Underdog
Zoe: 🟢 Celtics for me. defense + depth.
Nina: 🔵 Underdog. I live for chaos.
Tomas: 🟡 Bucks. Giannis once he gets going.
Ibrahim: Also, small logistics ask: can we move weekly scorer tie-break to 'total assists' instead of 'head-to-head points'? my team is built like a pass-first cult.
Maya: @league-commish tag? (not me)
Zoe: pro-tip: set your lineup early on Thursday nights. history will thank you.
Tomas: GIF: referee shrug (link)
court-bot: "court-bot: Transactionlog: Tomas claimed Smith-W at 11:12pm, waiver fee: 3.4 FAAB. Remaining FAAB: Tomas 6.6"
Ibrahim: oh wow Smith-W came through tonight, nice steal.
Nina: End thread: if anyone wants to swap sleeper recs or commiserate about dropped studs, DM me. also who wants to start a casual playoff bracket pool?"
